text:

BREAK DETAILS FOR RGL #6136 - Pass the Turkey NFL (Random Team) (11/25/26)
FORMAT: Random Team
ESTIMATED START TIME:  Wednesday, November 25th @ 8:45 PM PT
(All Start times are ESTIMATED and breaks can occur way later or earlier depending on stream pace. We recommend you check into the stream 2 hours prior to the start of your break to see where we're at in our night!)
PRODUCTS INCLUDED IN THIS BREAK:
- (1) 2026 Topps Chrome Hobby
- (1) 2026 Donruss Hobby
- (1) 2026 Obsidian FOTL
- (1) 2026 Bowman Sapphire
- (1) 2025 Prizm International
- (1) 2025 Revolution Premium
- (1) 2026 Topps Inception
PASS THE TURKEY Break Rules:
At the start of the break, one team will be randomly assigned the 'Turkey' (Target Number 1-32). The 'Turkey' can be passed to another team if that team pulls a serial numbered card that starts or ends with either digit in the target number. The team that has the turkey at the end of the break will receive $1000 store credit.
Example: The target number is set to 6 at the start of the break. Any team that gets a card with the left side serial starting or ending in six will receive the turkey (i.e. 6, 63, 26, etc) That team is now the turkey holder and the target number now changes to that card's numbers.
- All Cards Ship. (If you receive no cards a package will still be sent to you with courtesy pack(s))
- No Refunds or returns for this product once randomizations have been done.
- Break Replay can be watched in the live stream replay or on the Rungoodbreaks replay channel within 12 hours of the conclusion of the break.
- Please refer to our GROUP BREAK RULES page for more details and rules for our breaking community. 
(PLEASE READ: By purchasing into this break you acknowledge that with trading card group breaks there is no guarantee that you will receive a specific team, player or card. The trading card products featured in this event are blind package model products with contents unknown to all participants involved at point of purchase including the breaker (Rungoodlife).
